as_told.title: UAP drawn to nuclear and WMD facilities

plain: Many people in this field say that UFOs tend to appear near nuclear sites, such as nuclear weapons bases and power plants, all over the world. A researcher, Eric Hazeline, talks about the idea with care. He says it could be true or it could not, and he points out that there are many more sensors around nuclear plants, so more sightings might simply get recorded there. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says it more directly: UFOs show up around nuclear sites everywhere. A man who describes himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, goes furthest. He says it is established beyond reasonable doubt, and that the interest covers not just nuclear sites but all weapons of mass destruction, crediting a former Air Force officer, Robert Salas, and his work on UFOs and nukes. If true, it would suggest that whatever is behind these sightings is paying attention to humanity's most dangerous weapons.
